clue.text: Excellence of a sort

definitions.meaning: ... is high quality or distinction, as in a player with real ...
a kind or category of things

explanation.definitionFit: Both senses are standard: quality or distinction, and a category or kind.

clue.text: Appropriate naval officer crossing equator originally

indicators.note: crossing means the officer's title spans and so encloses the letter

parts.note: a commander is a naval rank

indicators.note: originally points to the opening letter of the word equator

explanation.surface: A naval officer seizes something as the ship crosses the equator.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Appropriate' looks like an adjective, but it is the verb, to take over.
explanation.definitionFit: To commandeer is to seize for one's own use, to appropriate.

clue.text: Reduced accommodation may be suitable

definitions.meaning: the short form of apartment, a home cut down to three letters

explanation.definitionFit: Apt is an adjective for fitting, and also the abbreviation of apartment.

clue.text: Hard English novelist

parts.note: stern means hard or severe

explanation.surface: A severe English writer of fiction.
explanation.definitionFit: Laurence Sterne was the eighteenth-century novelist who wrote Tristram Shandy.

clue.text: Painting Mr Chips, say?

definitions.meaning: a work by a great European painter of the past
Mr Chips is the elderly schoolmaster of Goodbye, Mr Chips, a veteran teacher

explanation.walkthrough: Mr Chips is the long-serving schoolteacher in James Hilton's novel Goodbye, Mr Chips: an old schoolmaster.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase names a great painter of earlier centuries or a canvas by one, and literally an aged teacher.

clue.text: Tell me how to be too clever for success

parts.note: to outwit someone is to be too clever for them
a hit is a success

explanation.surface: Someone asks for advice on outsmarting others to get ahead.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom urges someone to say what they are holding back, much like an impatient spill it.

clue.text: Poor scholar discovered by debt collector on outskirts of Cambridge

parts.note: a dun is someone who demands payment of debts

indicators.note: outskirts of points to the outer letters of the word Cambridge

explanation.surface: A failing student is found by a bailiff on the edge of Cambridge.
explanation.walkthrough: A dun is an old word for a debt collector, from the verb to dun, to press for payment.
explanation.definitionFit: A dunce is a slow or poor learner, the opposite of a good student.

clue.text: Having an uninteresting job, daughter is unable to move

parts.note: a chore is a dull routine task

explanation.surface: A daughter stuck in a boring job feels trapped.
explanation.definitionFit: A ship that is anchored is held fast, so it cannot drift or move.

clue.text: Bookmakers possibly being kind, going to the dogs

parts.note: a type is a kind or sort
setters are a breed of gun dog

explanation.surface: Bookies are the sort to end up at the greyhound track.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bookmakers' suggests bookies and 'going to the dogs' greyhound racing, but typesetters literally help make books.
explanation.definitionFit: Typesetters arrange type for printing, so in a playful sense they are makers of books.

clue.text: Foul row

definitions.meaning: a row or line, as of soldiers or taxis

explanation.definitionFit: Rank as an adjective means rancid and smelly; as a noun it means a line.

clue.text: Mould on the meat? It's by no means fresh

indicators.note: to mould is to shape or knead, so these letters are reshaped into a new word

explanation.surface: Meat that has gone mouldy is clearly past its best.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mould' reads as a noun, fungus on the meat, but it is a verb telling you to reshape ON THE MEAT.
explanation.definitionFit: Something eaten into by moths is shabby and worn, the opposite of fresh or new.

clue.text: Bird with better side

parts.note: to cap something is to better or outdo it
on is the leg side in cricket

explanation.surface: A bird paired with a superior team.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket the on side (leg side) is one half of the field, so 'side' gives ON.
explanation.definitionFit: A capon is a castrated cockerel, a type of bird raised for the table.

clue.text: Such ores featuring in workings?

indicators.note: workings here means being worked over, so the letters of the phrase are rearranged

explanation.surface: Mines yielding a certain kind of ore.
explanation.walkthrough: 'workings' suggests mines, where such ores really are found; as an indicator it puts ORES FEATURING to work, rearranging them.
explanation.definitionFit: Argentiferous means silver-bearing, describing ores containing silver, found in mine workings.

clue.text: Trenton's first to be involved with Great Danes in New Jersey

indicators.note: involved means tangled up, so the letters are mixed into a new order
first points to the opening letter of the word Trenton's

explanation.surface: Trenton's leading figure is mixed up with large dogs in New Jersey.
explanation.walkthrough: Trenton is the capital of New Jersey, which is nicknamed the Garden State.
explanation.definitionFit: The Garden State is the official nickname of New Jersey.

clue.text: One new centre-half on record as tending to stir up trouble

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

indicators.note: half here asks for the first half of the word centre it is attached to

parts.note: a diary is a daily record

explanation.surface: A newly signed centre-half is noted as a troublemaker.
explanation.walkthrough: 'centre-half' suggests a football defender, but it means half of the word centre.
explanation.definitionFit: Incendiary describes something inflammatory, likely to provoke conflict or unrest.

clue.text: Where retired people may be seen in Hollywood or Malibu

definitions.text: Where retired people may be seen

indicators.note: in tells us the letters sit inside the run of words Hollywood or Malibu

explanation.surface: Retired folk can be spotted living in Hollywood or Malibu.
explanation.walkthrough: 'retired' suggests pensioners in California, but here it means gone to bed: a dormitory is where sleepers are found.
explanation.definitionFit: A dormitory is a room for sleeping, so people who have retired for the night are found there.

clue.text: Room temperature favoured for red wine

parts.note: a chamber is a room
in means favoured or popular, as in the in crowd

explanation.surface: Red wine is best served at room temperature.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface is the familiar advice that red wine be served at room temperature.
explanation.definitionFit: Chambertin is a celebrated red Burgundy from Gevrey-Chambertin.

clue.text: Light in the still of the night? Nonsense!

definitions.text: Light in the still of the night?
definitions.meaning: moonlight shining at night, with a nod to illicit liquor from a still

explanation.definitionFit: Moonshine is moonlight, illicitly distilled spirits, and foolish or fanciful talk.

clue.text: Larks in a strange land

indicators.note: strange means odd or out of place, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Larks found in an unfamiliar country.
explanation.definitionFit: Sri Lanka is an island country, a land in the Indian Ocean.

clue.text: Board member getting dole is cursing

parts.note: an exec, an executive, sits on a company board
to dole out is to ration; a ration is a doled-out share

explanation.surface: A company director on the dole swears about it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dole' suggests unemployment benefit, but here it is an allotted share.
explanation.definitionFit: Execration is the act of cursing or denouncing something bitterly.

clue.text: Top player in audition is to give up

indicators.note: audition means hearing, so the word is taken as heard rather than as written

parts.note: a seed is a top-ranked player in a tennis tournament

explanation.surface: A star performer at an audition decides to quit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'audition' suggests a tryout, but here it means simply hearing.
explanation.definitionFit: To cede is to surrender or yield something, giving it up to another.

clue.text: Don't go about with chief

parts.note: re means about or concerning
main means chief or principal

explanation.surface: A plea to stay put with the boss.
explanation.definitionFit: To remain is to stay where one is, so the command means stay.

clue.text: Ultimately Christmas fairy had to be cool, calm and collected

indicators.note: ultimately points to the final letter of the word Christmas

parts.note: an elf is a kind of fairy
had means owned, held as one's own

explanation.surface: The fairy on top of the tree had to keep composed at Christmas.
explanation.definitionFit: Self-possessed means composed and in control of one's feelings, as the idiom cool, calm and collected says.

clue.text: Taken from place to place, as water music may be

definitions.text: Taken from place to place, as water
definitions.meaning: water is conveyed through pipes from one place to another
... music is recorded background music played in public places

explanation.definitionFit: Piped describes water carried by pipe and background music relayed by speakers.

clue.text: Garments similar to cloaks but not carbon copies

indicators.note: but not means leave out the named letter

parts.note: capes are sleeveless garments like cloaks
C is the chemical symbol for carbon

explanation.surface: Cloak-like garments that are originals, not duplicates.
explanation.walkthrough: 'carbon copies' reads as one phrase, but carbon is C and copies is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: To ape is to imitate, so apes means copies.

clue.text: Frank is not attractive

definitions.meaning: frank speech is ..., blunt and direct
a ... person is homely, lacking good looks

explanation.definitionFit: Plain covers both outspoken and unremarkable in looks.

clue.text: Strait-laced woman covering a Botticelli painting

indicators.note: covering means the outer pieces enclose the single letter

parts.note: prim means prudish and strait-laced
Vera is a woman's name

explanation.surface: A prudish woman covers up a Renaissance nude.
explanation.definitionFit: Primavera, meaning spring, is Botticelli's famous allegorical painting in the Uffizi.

clue.text: For starters, eat oysters? Never in a thousand million years

indicators.note: starters means beginnings, so take the opening letters of the words that follow

explanation.surface: Someone vows they will never eat oysters as an appetiser.
explanation.walkthrough: 'starters' suggests a first course of oysters, but it signals initial letters.
explanation.definitionFit: In geology an eon is a span of a billion years; loosely it means an age.

clue.text: King Edward's on his horse? Run away!

indicators.note: being on a horse means sitting in its seat, so the royal letters go inside

parts.note: his horse stands here for its seat, the saddle a rider sits in
K is the abbreviation for king, as in chess
Ed is the short form of Edward

explanation.surface: A king mounts his horse and tells everyone to flee.
explanation.walkthrough: A rider who is on his horse sits in its seat, so the clue's 'on his horse' is read as being in the saddle; 'on' is the container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Skedaddle is an informal word meaning to run off in a hurry.

clue.text: Birthplace of Edmond de Goncourt and one of the Mitford sisters

definitions.meaning: the French writer Edmond de Goncourt was born in this city in Lorraine
the novelist author of The Pursuit of Love was the eldest Mitford sister

explanation.definitionFit: Nancy is a city in north-east France and the first name of the novelist Nancy Mitford.
